notes: Reference date 2018-02-28. The APM sections are systemwide UC policy captured 2017-03 to 2018-05 with revision dates 2000-2015; the UCI APP pages and FAQ are Academic Personnel web pages captured March-April 2018. All read as in force on the reference date.

Which policy: APM 760, 710, 715, 133, 700, 758, 759 (UC systemwide) govern; the UCI APP 7-10 to 7-44 and 3-50 pages implement them on campus; the FAQ (2018_08) and Family Friendly Resources page (2018_16) are summaries. No campus provision differs from the APM in a length except as noted (APP 7-42 states the birth mother's two-quarter total as 'may not exceed'; APP 7-43 applies the 12-month window to the whole parental leave). The resources page (2018_16) is a list of links and holds no policy text of its own.

Population: Academic Senate (ladder-rank) faculty on academic-year (quarter) appointments. Faculty do not accrue sick leave or vacation (APM 710-0; FAQ 19), so the own-accrual substitutions (c19) and the non-Senate childbearing pay (c20) are recorded for other groups.

Calendar: UC Irvine is on quarters ('Academic Year Appointments are expected to be in residence from the first day of the fall quarter through the last day of the spring quarter', APP 7-10); no quarter length stated, so calendar.kind = quarter, and the term length follows R8's order. Where the APM states 'two quarters (or two semesters)', the quarter alternative is coded (R8).

Birth parent chain: childbearing leave/pregnancy disability leave (c2, up to 4 months) with its paid first 6 weeks (c1) inside it and inside ASMD (c7, a total of two quarters of childbearing leave plus ASMD) and FMLA (c3) alongside from the start (discretionary paid FMLA c6 within FMLA) -> CFRA (c4) and the unpaid parental leave (c5, up to 1 year), both starting at the end of the childbearing leave; APM 710 medical leave (c13, with its pay c14, then unpaid extension c15) also available in addition; all leaves plus ASMD capped at one year (leave_limits).
